address: 2F, Intercontinental Chiang Mai The Mae Ping, 153 Room 2A, Sridonchai Road, Chang Khlan, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50100, Thailand
bio: This confident new face on Chiang Mai's dining scene brings a refined energy to the table. Local ingredients play a central role – fruit, vegetables, tea, even cheese – and are elevated by sharp European cuisine technique. The experience begins with an aperitif in a playful, book-lined lounge, then you move into the intimate 18-seat dining room anchored by a chamchuri wood counter. Don't miss the goat's cheese flan paired with seasonal fruits: it's smooth and effortlessly moreish....
